title: Why Monthly Tire Pressure Checks Matter in Saskatoon
caption: With our city’s shifting temperatures, keeping your tires properly inflated can improve fuel economy and safety. Here’s a quick guide: check pressure when tires are cold, use the recommended psi in your owner’s manual, and top off as needed. Regular checks help avoid uneven wear and keep your drive smooth.

title: How to Know When It’s Time for Brake Service
caption: If you hear squeaking, feel vibrations, or notice longer stopping distances, your brakes need attention. Ignoring these signs can affect safety. A mobile mechanic can inspect and service your brakes at your home or workplace, so you don’t have to wait at a shop.
